title: Los Angeles County Departments Homelessness Programs / Support City Residents
motion: I THEREFORE MOVE that the City Council instruct the Chief Legislative Analyst to collaborate with the Los Angeles County Department of Public Health, the Department of Mental Health, the Department of Health Services, and the Department of Social Services, to report within 60 days on: • All homelessness programs that each County department funds to support City residents and their funding source. The total number of staff assigned to each homelessness program that supports City residents. The frequency of physical visits by County department staff to interim housing sites or Inside Safe sites located in the City. The total number of calls that each County department receives requesting homelessness services within the City limits. The County’s process for prioritizing the City of Los Angeles’ request for service, including criteria for prioritization and response mechanisms. I FURTHER MOVE that the City Council instruct the Chief Legislative Analyst to include in the report recommendations on potential mechanisms and methods that the City could use to more effectively engage with these departments. MRO PRESENTED BY: AAA YSABEL JURADO / I mes Councilmember, 14th District OCT 0 6 2026 SECONDED BY;

requests.asks: County homelessness programs that serve City residents, including funding sources, staffing, site visits, call volume and the County's prioritization of City requests, with recommendations on how the City can better engage County departments.
